Mission

Engineering Services

Architectural design, structural engineering, civil and technical services — complete lifecycle engineering for your project.

What We Provide

Full-lifecycle engineering — from first sketch to structural certification

All design work complies with Nepal Building Code (NBC), Lumbini Province municipality requirements, and ETABS seismic structural analysis. We stay through the full process — from schematic design to permit approval.

01

Architectural Engineering

Architectural Planning & Floor Plans

Site layout, room programming and detailed floor plans for all levels — dimensioned, annotated and ready for permit submission.

Building Elevations & Sections

Full exterior elevation drawings and cross-sections with finish materials, openings and heights indicated.

3D Visualization & Rendering

Three-dimensional models and rendered elevations to visualize the final built form before construction.

Building Permit Drawing Sets

Complete permit sets to municipality requirements — architectural, structural, site plan, services layouts.

Architectural Details & Documentation

Wall sections, stair details, roof details and construction assemblies for contractor use.

02

Structural Engineering

Structural Design (RCC)

Complete reinforced concrete design for beams, columns, slabs and foundations to Nepal Building Code standards.

ETABS Structural Analysis

Professional seismic structural analysis using ETABS — the international standard for building structural analysis.

Foundation Design

Isolated, combined and mat foundation design sized for local soil conditions and building loads.

Structural Detailing & Bar Schedules

Column, beam and slab reinforcement detailing drawings and bar bending schedules for contractor use.

Structural Design Reports

Formal structural design reports for permit submission and professional record.

03

Civil & Technical Services

Quantity Estimation

Systematic measurement of all construction works from approved drawings — ready for pricing and procurement.

Bill of Quantities (BOQ)

Detailed BOQ in standard format — itemised by trade and work category for tendering or contractor negotiation.

Cost Estimation

Project cost estimates at current market rates — realistic budget expectations before commitment.

Site Survey & Topographic Mapping

Site boundary survey, topographic survey and contour mapping for accurate site planning.

Technical Reports & Documentation

Structural reports, feasibility studies and construction documentation for permit submission.

Artisan Engineering Academy

Practical engineering software training — delivered by engineers, for engineers. Learn the tools used on real projects.

Why Artisan Academy?

Learn the Tools Engineers Use.

Artisan Engineering Academy is not a generic computer institute. Every course is taught by practising engineers who use these tools daily on real structural and architectural projects in Nepal.

The emphasis is on practical application — real project workflows, real drawing exercises and real structural models, not isolated software buttons.

  • Taught by practising engineers — not general IT instructors
  • Practical, project-based learning from day one
  • Small batch sizes — individual attention guaranteed
  • Certificate of completion provided
  • Open to students, graduates and working professionals
  • Courses conducted in Nepali language

ACADEMY FAQ
Questions

Academy FAQ

Do I need prior engineering knowledge to join?

For AutoCAD, basic computer skills are sufficient. For ETABS and STAAD.Pro, a foundation in structural engineering principles is helpful. Contact us and we'll advise on the best course for your background.

Are courses conducted in Nepali?

Yes. Training is conducted in Nepali with technical terminology explained in both Nepali and English.

Do you provide a certificate?

Yes. A certificate of completion is issued by Artisan Engineering and Builders Pvt. Ltd. upon successful completion.

How do I enrol?

Contact us via WhatsApp on +977-9829635328, call us, or submit an enquiry through our contact form. We will confirm batch schedule and available seats.

Where is training conducted?

Training is conducted at our office in Nepalgunj, Banke District. Contact us for current class schedule and directions.

Start Your Engineering Training

Limited seats per batch. Contact us to confirm availability and enrol.

FAQ
Common Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I start a building design project?

Contact us by phone, WhatsApp or enquiry form. We arrange an initial consultation to understand your requirements, site conditions and intended use, then advise on the appropriate services.

What does a building permit drawing set include?

A standard permit set includes: site plan, floor plans for all levels, all elevations, cross-sections, structural plan, foundation plan and municipality-required notes — prepared to your specific municipality's format.

Do you provide structural analysis for earthquake safety?

Yes. We use ETABS for seismic structural analysis per Nepal Building Code. Nepal's seismic zone classification is incorporated into all structural designs. We do not compromise on structural safety.

Can you provide BOQ from existing drawings?

Yes. If you have approved drawings we can prepare a BOQ and cost estimate without redesigning. Contact us with your drawing set.

Do you provide construction services or only design?

Artisan provides both — architectural design, structural engineering, construction and supervision — the full lifecycle from concept to completed building.

What areas do you serve for construction?

Construction and supervision services cover Banke, Bardiya, Surkhet, Dang, Kapilvastu, Rupandehi and Pyuthan. Engineering design and consultancy are available nationwide.

How is construction quality controlled?

Our engineers make regular site visits at all critical stages — foundation, column reinforcement, slab, concrete pours and masonry. Deviations are corrected before the next stage proceeds.

How much does construction cost?

Cost depends on location, floor area, number of storeys, structural specification and site conditions. Contact us for a detailed estimate.

Which engineering software do you teach?

AutoCAD (primary course), ETABS, STAAD.Pro and Quantity Estimation & BOQ. Contact us for current batch availability.

Do I need prior knowledge to join?

For AutoCAD, basic computer skills are sufficient. For ETABS and STAAD.Pro, a foundation in structural engineering is helpful.

Are courses conducted in Nepali?

Yes. Training is conducted in Nepali with technical terminology in both Nepali and English.

Do you provide a certificate on completion?

Yes. A certificate of completion is issued by Artisan Engineering and Builders Pvt. Ltd. upon successful completion.

How do I enrol?

Contact us via WhatsApp on +977-9829635328, call us, or submit an enquiry through our contact form. We will confirm batch schedule and seats.
